title: The Little Escape — scene 1, the farmhouse

lines.speaker: the-major
lines.text: Cock-a-doodle-doo! Step aside, ladies. Frederick Peckle, cock of the walk, is here!

lines.speaker: petra
lines.text: Oh look, Ols! Aren't they adorable? Four of them! They'll keep us busy while we can't go out. How much are they, Mrs Hubbard?

lines.speaker: mrs-hubbard
lines.text: Well... costs have gone up, up, a hundred and twenty pounds cash for all four.

lines.speaker: oliver
lines.text: Sorry, Hubbard. What else will we need, and how much would that be?
